overall: MARGINAL this morning, GOOD from ~3 PM through Tue 20
limiterDetail: Main limiter: a combination. Rain from light showers ~6 AM to 2 PM (up to 1.5–1.6 mm/h at Barangonan and Linapacan), wind in the south and east (Nangalao 10–13 kt until ~7 PM, Ciron 11–12 kt until noon), and current at Tara (0.9–1.3 kt all 24h) and Turda (0.7–1.1 kt). ECMWF still rates Mon 19 GOOD for the day (5.8 kt, gusts 11, current 0.3 kt, ~5 mm).

pagasa.status: no gale, tropical cyclone wind signal or heavy-rain warning
pagasa.detail: PAGASA: no gale, tropical cyclone wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. General Flood Advisory #2, Region 4-B (MIMAROPA) , Mon 19 Oct 5:13 AM PHT (follows GFA #1, Sun 5:36 PM): ITCZ affecting Palawan, light to moderate rain and thunderstorms for the next 12 hours, Busuanga and Coron rivers listed; valid to ~5:13 PM today.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: Tue 20 is back to GOOD (6.9 kt, gusts 12, current 0.4 kt, ~2.8 mm), so the good spell now runs Mon 19 and Tue 20 and Tuesday's supply moves up to ABOVE NORMAL. The other side got worse: Thu 22 dropped to POOR (11 kt, gusts 16, current 0.9 kt), the only POOR day of the week, and the 3-day supply outlook is now BELOW NORMAL.
Sat 24's heavy rain is gone (now mostly dry, 6.3 kt), but ~14.2 mm of rain has moved onto Sun 25. Shortage risk stays ELEVATED but shifts a day later (Wed 21 to Sun 25 catch). Surge flag stays OFF.

New PAGASA flood advisory: General Flood Advisory #2 for MIMAROPA (Mon 5:13 AM PHT) says the ITCZ is affecting Palawan, with light to moderate rain and thunderstorms over the next 12 hours; Busuanga and Coron rivers are on the watch list. It's a land flood advisory, not a gale or storm signal.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged): good arrivals Mon 19 to Wed 21 morning, but no multi-day surge. Shortage risk stays ELEVATED , now for the Wed 21 to Sun 25 catch, felt Thu 22 to Mon 26. Buying ahead on Mon 19 and Tue 20 still makes sense.

bestWindow.headline: ~3 PM today to Tue 6 AM (Coron, Culion, Galoc)
details: ~3 PM to Tue 6 AM: Coron, Culion and Galoc have 0–2 kt wind, 0.2–0.3 kt current and almost no rain (0.2 mm/h or less). Maglalambay and Panlaitan join from ~4 PM (3–4 kt, current 0.0–0.3). The model's calmest hour is ~Tue 4 AM at Galoc.
Daytime option: Decabobo is GOOD all day (2–6 kt from ~10 AM, current 0.1–0.4, only ~3.9 mm over 24h). Alava and Binudac are easiest ~6–8 PM (1–4 kt, current 0.3).

Keep boats off Nangalao until ~7 PM and off Ciron until ~7 PM; both ease to under 8 kt after that, but expect a shower ~9–11 PM. Avoid Tara for the full 24h (current never below 0.9 kt); Turda is best this morning before ~1 PM (0.7–0.9 kt).
